title: control.bootstrap.progressed v1 data
description: A bootstrap run advanced one stage. Emitted by the CLI so a dashboard can follow a fork operator's first install; every event of one run shares a `correlationid`. Evolved additively within v1: new OPTIONAL fields only. A new required field, a removed field or a retyped field is a v2.

stage.description: Stage identifier, stable across runs and forks (e.g. `talos-config`, `cilium`, `argocd`, `app-of-apps`).

stageIndex.description: Zero-based position of this stage in the run.

stageCount.description: Total stages in the run, so a consumer can render progress without knowing the stage list.

durationSeconds.description: Wall-clock seconds for the stage; absent on `started`.

message.description: Human-readable detail. Never parsed, and MUST NOT carry secrets or rendered config.
